conditions: The array-type being described explicitly specifies exactly one index type in its own index list.
limitations: The claim concerns logical component mapping. The component type can itself be an array type. The multi-index shorthand has separate nesting rules. This claim does not cover storage layout, packing, bound conventions, or conformant-array parameter rules.
Exact unextended ISO/IEC 7185:1990 online replica. The replica gives the printed text precedence where they differ. ISO 10206 Extended Pascal and product dialects require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: For an array-type specifying exactly one index type in ISO/IEC 7185:1990 Pascal, that index type is ordinal. Every value specified by the index type maps to a distinct component of the type denoted by the array-type's component-type.
